name: final_page_visual_jpeg

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,base64
from pathlib import Path
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','8','-l','8','-scale-to','1400','-singlefile','-jpeg','-jpegopt','quality=55','sources/simplex-final.pdf'],capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(); w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/final-page8.jpg','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True); assert w.returncode==0
print('IMAGE64:'+b+'\nENDIMAGE')
